================================================================================
Named immediate regex keyword remains valid alongside a word alternative
================================================================================
.match!
---
(program (keyword))

================================================================================
Whitespace prevents a named reserved immediate regex keyword
:error
================================================================================
. match!
---
(ERROR (keyword))

================================================================================
Newline prevents a named reserved immediate regex keyword
:error
================================================================================
.
match!
---
(ERROR (keyword))

================================================================================
Reserved regex spelling cannot be accepted as a word
:error
================================================================================
.match?
---
(ERROR (keyword))

================================================================================
Whitespace does not let a word bypass regex reservation
:error
================================================================================
. match?
---
(ERROR (keyword))

================================================================================
Longer word with the reserved regex prefix remains valid
================================================================================
.matcher?
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Unreserved word remains valid after whitespace
================================================================================
. other?
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Empty reservation context permits the keyword spelling as a word
================================================================================
:match?
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Empty reservation context permits whitespace before the keyword spelling
================================================================================
: match?
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Short general immediate regex spelling remains valid
================================================================================
;stop!
---
(program (general_keyword))

================================================================================
Long general immediate regex spelling remains valid
================================================================================
;stops!
---
(program (general_keyword))

================================================================================
Whitespace prevents a reserved general immediate regex
:error
================================================================================
; stop!
---
(ERROR (general_keyword))

================================================================================
Short general regex spelling remains reserved after whitespace
:error
================================================================================
; stop?
---
(ERROR (general_keyword))

================================================================================
Long general regex spelling remains reserved after whitespace
:error
================================================================================
; stops?
---
(ERROR (general_keyword))

================================================================================
General regex prefix remains an unreserved longer word after whitespace
================================================================================
; stopping?
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
General immediate regex retains its explicit precedence over longer words
:error
================================================================================
;stopping?
---
(program (ERROR (general_keyword)) (word))

================================================================================
Empty reservation context permits general regex spellings
================================================================================
: stops?
---
(program (word))
